reason: Main method is fast intraday reaction to event-driven news and merger-arb catalysts with no overnight holds; edge requires real-time headline reaction and pre-event research that cannot be approximated on daily bars.

universe.description: US equities with announced or rumored corporate actions (mergers, antitrust, activist bids)

setup.rule: Maintain deep pre-event knowledge of 30-40 situations including deal terms, approvals needed, incorporation state
setup.quote: I keep track of every single one of them and I know, you know, who the buyer is, what the price is, you know, what antitrust approvals are needed

entry.rule: React instantly to new headline or filing if still within 2-3s window and stock has not yet moved
entry.quote: Boom boom boom, I type the ticker in and boom boom boom, I hit the hot key

stop.rule: Hard mental P&L stop; exit immediately if hit
stop.quote: there's like a rough P&L thing that I have in my head where if I hit that I just got to get out

exits.rule: Exit once information is on tape for a few minutes or when arbs arrive and price reaches expected level
exits.quote: once a couple of minutes goes by on event-driven news that hits the tape, there's nothing to do

sizing.rule: Scale to high confidence level; go large when edge is clear and liquidity allows
sizing.quote: if I get a chance to do to get really big in something, I will

ambiguities.issue: Mentions macro positioning side strategy but states main activity remains event-driven intraday
ambiguities.assumption: Focus on primary merger-arb/event-driven method only
